subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Zoe and Mila
email_body:
Hi Jodie,

I came across Zoe and Mila, your August 2025 novel about two friends tangled up in gang trouble while trying to win back an office foosball table, and the mix of humour and real-world stakes made me smile. It also sits nicely alongside the way you have spoken about weaving grittier themes into easy-to-read Kiwi stories.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

A short trailer or a few reels for Zoe and Mila is something you may have been considering, and if so, we can handle the full production, from concept to finished clips ready to share with readers. It is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Zoe and Mila best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
